description: Popular brands like Realme, OnePlus, and Motorola have introduced several new handsets in the mid-range smartphone segment with upgraded hardware and fresh features. Our latest recommendations under Rs. 30,000 include models like the Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, Realme P4 Power and OnePlus Nord CE 6. Most smartphones in this segment use mid-range chipsets from Qualcomm and MediaTek, and feature AMOLED displays.
title: Best Smartphones in India Under Rs. 30,000: OnePlus Nord CE 6, Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, More

description: SpaceX successfully launched and docked its Dragon capsule at the International Space Station under NASA’s CRS-34 mission. The spacecraft delivered cargo, scientific equipment, and advanced research experiments focused on bone health, microgravity simulation, and charged particles around Earth. Astronauts aboard the ISS will unload and later return research materials to Earth.
title: SpaceX Dragon Capsule Reaches ISS Carrying 6,500 Pounds of Supplies

description: Red Magic 11S Pro series has been launched in China. They feature a 6.85-inch 1.5K BOE X10 OLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate. Both smartphones are powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Leading Edition chipset. The Red Magic 11S Pro packs an 8,000mAh battery with support for 80W fast charging. Meanwhile, the Red Magic 11S Pro+ has a 7,500mAh battery with 120W wired charging support, along with 80W wireless charging support.
title: Red Magic 11S Pro, Red Magic 11S Pro+ Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Leading Edition SoC: Price, Specifications

description: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Finance, chaired by BJP MP Bhartruhari Mahtab, will meet representatives from Binance, WazirX, and ZebPay on May 20 to discuss Virtual Digital Assets in India. Officials from IFSCA, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs are also scheduled to appear before the panel.
title: Binance, WazirX, ZebPay Summoned by Parliament Panel On May 20 Over VDAs

description: The best TWS earbuds under Rs. 5,000 in India now offer features such as ANC, high-resolution audio, and long battery life. The Oppo Enco Buds 3 Pro+ provides a balanced overall package, while the GoBoult Tenet stands out with up to 75 hours of battery life. The JBL Wave Beam 2 offers reliable ANC and app support. The Realme Buds Air 8 and OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro deliver more advanced features, including LHDC audio and up to 55dB ANC.
title: Best TWS Earbuds Under Rs 5,000 in India: Oppo Enco Buds 3 Pro+, OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro and More

description: Meta recently introduced Instagram Instants, offering a new way for users to share photos on the social media platform. The feature lets you “instantly” share disappearing photos with your friends or select close friends on the social media app. With the new tool, the platform is competing with Snapchat, which is primarily built for sharing ephemeral photos and videos. You can add a caption to the photos you share. However, Meta says that the feature has been designed to allow you to only share images with “minimal edits”. Hence, you can not add additional filters to the images after clicking the photo.
title: Instagram Instants Explained: What It Is, How It Works, Features and More

description: Directed by Jai Basant Singh, Satrangi: Badle Ka Khel is an upcoming crime thriller series that explores themes of crime, societal inequality, and power.
title: Satrangi: Badle Ka Khel OTT Release Date Revealed: Know Everything About Plot, Cast, and More

description: YouTube is finally ready to release its Likeness Detection tool to all adult creators on the platform. After first announcing it in 2024, the company has also expanded its access to users. Last year, a select group of content creators received the tool, and in March this year, the streaming giant opened the deepfake spotting tool to government officials and journalists.
title: YouTube’s Likeness Detection Tool Is Now Available to All Adult Creators

description: Withdrawing money from the Provident Fund (PF) used to be a cumbersome task, one that depended upon employer approval and manual verification. However, that is not the case anymore. The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has streamlined the process through a digital claim system under the new EPFO framework. The process can be directly completed using the EPFO member portal using OTP-based verification if your Universal Account Number (UAN), Aadhaar, PAN, and bank details are properly linked and verified.
title: How to Claim PF Online Without Employer Approval Under New EPFO Rules: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Vodafone Idea has launched new international roaming plans for postpaid customers in India. The updated portfolio now includes 17 packs with validity ranging from one day to 30 days and prices starting at Rs. 649. Select plans offer unlimited data, voice, and SMS in more than 40 countries, while over 120 destinations receive fixed allowances. The new options include seven-day, 14-day, and 21-day packs. Customers can purchase and manage these plans through the Vi app.
title: Vi Postpaid Users in India Can Choose New International Roaming Plans From Rs 649

description: Verus Protocol’s Ethereum bridge was reportedly exploited after an attacker used a fake cross-chain transfer message to move over $11.5 million in crypto assets. Blockchain security firms said the funds were later swapped for Ether.
title: Verus Ethereum Bridge Reportedly Suffers from $11.5 Million DeFi Hack

description: Realme 16 series has received a price increase in the country. The price of the Realme 16, Realme 16 Pro and Realme 16 Pro+ smartphones has been increased significantly. Besides Realme, brands like OnePlus, Poco and Lava have also raised the prices of thier mid range phones in India. The price of the OnePlus 15R, Poco X8 Pro Max, and Poco M8 5G has been increased in India.
title: Realme 16 Series Gets Price Hike in India; OnePlus, Poco and Lava Also Revise Rates

description: Realme has confirmed that the Realme 16T 5G will feature a 50-megapixel Sony IMX852 camera with AI-based imaging tools ahead of its India launch on May 22. The smartphone will also offer AI Portrait Glow, a 144Hz display, 2,100 nits peak brightness, and IP69 protection. Earlier teasers confirmed an 8,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging. The handset is expected to use the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and will be sold via Flipkart, realme.com, and offline stores.
title: Realme 16T 5G Camera Specifications Confirmed Ahead of May 22 India Launch

description: Created by Vignesh Natarajan, Warrant is an upcoming Tamil crime thriller series that stars Prasanth Pandiyaraj in the lead role. Streaming begins on May 22nd, 2026, on Zee 5.
title: Prasanth Pandiyaraj’s Warrant OTT Release Details Revealed: Know When and Where to Watch it Online

description: Xiaomi 17T series will be launched in select global markets on May 28, the tech giant announced on Monday. On top of this, the company has confirmed that the Xiaomi 17T lineup will boast a Leica-tuned rear camera module, housing a triple camera setup. While other details about the upcoming series remain under wraps, a tipster has shared the official-looking renders of the Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro, revealing their design, key specifications, and features. The Pro model is tipped to be equipped with a 6.83-inch display that refreshes at up to 144Hz. On the other hand, the standard model could be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra SoC.
title: Xiaomi 17T Series Set to Launch Globally on May 28; Confirmed to Arrive With a Leica-Tuned Cameras

description: Written and directed by Bruce Beresford, The Travellers is an emotional Australian drama film that is now available to stream only on Netflix.
title: The Travellers Now Streaming on Netflix: Know Everything About This Australian Drama Film

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will be launched in India soon, the smartphone maker revealed on Monday. On top of this, a dedicated microsite for the unveiling of the upcoming handset is now live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. The Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ is shown to be identical to the recently launched Motorola Edge 70 Pro. The new Pro+ model will go on sale in India in brown, red, and teal colour options, featuring a sculpted wood finish, satin-luxe finish, and twill-inspired finish, respectively.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ India Launch Teased; Availability, Design and Colourways Revealed

description: The Sony Inzone H6 Air was launched in India on Monday. The gaming headset comes equipped with an open-back acoustic design. As per the company, it features 40mm drivers and 360 Spatial Sound for gaming. It is positioned as the lightest headset in Sony’s Inzone lineup, tipping the scales at 199g. Sony claims it has been designed for immersive gaming sessions with support for PCs, smartphones, and PS5 controllers. The Sony Inzone H6 Air comes bundled with a detachable cardioid boom microphone, USB Type-C audio box, and 3.5mm wired connectivity.
title: Sony Inzone H6 Air Launched in India With Open-Back Design, 360 Spatial Sound: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin traded near $77,000 on Monday as rising geopolitical tensions, ETF outflows, and macroeconomic pressure weighed on crypto market sentiment. Analysts said investors remain cautious ahead of the upcoming FOMC minutes, while weakening institutional flows continue to limit upside momentum.
title: Bitcoin Slips Toward $77,000 as ETF Outflows Weigh on Crypto Sentiment

description: Google is said to be working on allowing users to move passkeys stored on their Android handset across apps. The company could soon add options in the Password Manager for importing and exporting both passwords and passkeys. The currently available "Import passwords and Export passwords options will soon be replaced by new Import passwords & passkeys and Export passwords & passkeys options.
title: Google Reportedly Testing Passkey Transfer Support in Google Password Manager

description: OpenAI’s latest image generation model in ChatGPT has become massively popular in India. The company CEO, Sam Altman, revealed on Monday that Indian users have collectively generated more than one billion images using ChatGPT Images 2.0. The statistic is significant given the fact that the model was released on the chatbot’s platform on April 21, meaning the milestone arrived in less than a month’s time.
title: OpenAI’s Sam Altman Says Indian Users Created Over 1 Billion Images With ChatGPT Images 2.0

description: iQOO Z11 Lite 5G has reportedly appeared on Geekbench with the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, 8GB of RAM, and Android 16. The phone carries the model number I2510 and was previously spotted on IMEI and Indonesian certification platforms. The listing suggests that the handset may launch as the most affordable model in the Z11 series. It could also support 44W fast charging and may be priced below Rs. 20,000 if it launches in India.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite 5G Reportedly Spotted on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC

description: Panda Plan 2 premieres on Lionsgate Play on May 22, 2026. Starring Jackie Chan, the film follows Jackie and panda Hu Hu as they uncover a mysterious portal, encounter a panda-worshipping tribe and battle dangerous events in a mystical jungle adventure.
title: Panda Plan 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Jackie Chan Starrer Movie Online?

description: Vivo S60 will be equipped with a 7,200mAh battery, Vivo Product Manager Han Boxiao announced on Monday. The upcoming phone is also confirmed to arrive with support for 90W wired fast charging via a USB Type-C port. The new Vivo S60 will be unveiled with a 3D ultrasonic fingerprint scanner for security, too. This comes shortly after the company executive began teasing the design of the soon-to-be-launched handset. It is confirmed to arrive with the latest Vivo TWS 5e.
title: Vivo S60 Confirmed to Launch With a Significantly Larger Battery Than Its Predecessor

description: Forza Horizon 6 is an early access hit. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced that the open-world racing title had become the most played early access title in series history. Forza Horizon 6 early access began May 15, but the game will fully launch on May 19.
title: Forza Horizon 6 Is the Most Played Early Access Title in Series History, Says Xbox

description: Apple’s foldable iPhone reportedly hit another hurdle during its latest trial production stage. While Apple has reportedly made significant progress in minimising display creases, internal testing has reportedly revealed issues with the hinge mechanism. The reliability after frequent opening and closing consistently fails to meet Apple's quality control standards. This problem is expected to delay the launch of the iPhone Fold.
title: Apple’s Foldable iPhone Reportedly Facing Hinge Reliability Problems in Testing

description: Motorola has confirmed that the Moto Buds 2 will launch in India on May 19. The TWS earbuds feature an 11mm dynamic driver and a 6mm micro planar magnetic driver. They support LHDC audio, Spatial Audio, and up to 55dB active noise cancellation. Other features include Bluetooth 6.0, dual-device connectivity, and an IP54 rating. The earbuds offer up to 11 hours of playback on a charge and up to 48 hours with the charging case.
title: Moto Buds 2 to Launch in India Alongside Moto G37 Series; Flipkart Availability Confirmed

description: The OnePlus Ace 6 was launched in China in October 2025 as the company’s latest performance-focused smartphone. Leaks about its successor have already begun surfacing. A tipster suggests that the purported handset, dubbed the OnePlus Ace 7, could be powered by Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. It is said to sport an OLED screen with the highest refresh rate of any OnePlus phone to date. The OnePlus Ace 7 could pack a 9,000mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Said to be in Testing With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, Up to 240Hz Display

description: Oppo Reno 16 series will be launched in China on May 25 at 6 pm local time (3:30 pm IST), according to a tipster. Moreover, the tech firm has confirmed that the Oppo Pad 6 and Oppo Enco Air 5s true wireless stereo (TWS) will be launched in China on the same date. The new tablets are confirmed to ship with an unspecified version of ColorOS. In terms of design, the Oppo Pad 6 appears to be similar to its predecessor. The Oppo Pad 6 is shown to feature a single rear camera system and an LED flash, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series Tipped to Debut Next Week Alongside Oppo Pad 6, Enco Air 5s

description: OpenAI released a preview of a new personal finance experience in ChatGPT on Friday. Available to Pro subscribers in the US, the new capability connects the chatbot with the user’s various finance accounts to contextually answer any personal finance-related queries. The experience also adds a new dashboard that shows a visual representation of the user’s expenditure, savings, investments, and mortgages.
title: ChatGPT Can Now Manage Your Personal Finances With New Tools and Features

description: Xiaomi 17 Max will be launched in China on May 21, the smartphone maker announced on Monday. The new handset will be accompanied by the Xiaomi Band 10 Pro and the company’s first clip-on style true wireless stereo (TWS), dubbed Xiaomi Ear Clip. The upcoming launch event will also see the unveiling of the Xiaomi YU7 GT 2026, the tech giant’s latest electric SUV. We already know that the Xiaomi 17 Max will be launched as the newest member of the lineup, which currently includes Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Pro, Xiaomi 17 Pro Max, and Xiaomi 17 Ultra.
title: Xiaomi 17 Max Launch Date Announced; Will Arrive This Week Along With Band 10 Pro, Xiaomi Ear Clip TWS

description: Apple is reportedly preparing an enhancement to Genmoji in iOS 27 and iPadOS 27. According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the update will add an optional Suggested Genmoji feature that creates emoji suggestions using photos and frequently typed phrases. Apple introduced Genmoji in 2024 as part of Apple Intelligence, but the feature faced criticism over image quality and battery drain. The new option aims to make Genmoji easier to use for casual users and could remain powered by on-device processing.
title: Apple to Upgrade Genmoji in iOS 27 With Smarter Emoji Suggestions: Mark Gurman

description: Samsung Galaxy M47 and Galaxy F70 Pro have appeared on the BIS certification site, carrying the model numbers SM-M476B/DS and SM-E476B/DS, respectively. While the certification listing does not reveal their specifications, it suggests that they will launch in India soon. The Galaxy M47 is likely to feature a  6.7-inch AMOLED panel and a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset. It is tipped to feature a  5,000mAh battery and a triple rear camera unit.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47, Galaxy F70 Pro Appear on BIS Listing; India Launch May Be Imminent

description: Apple is said to be preparing a major overhaul of Siri for iOS 27 as part of its artificial intelligence (AI) efforts, and at the forefront could be the standalone app. The Cupertino-based tech giant is expected to unveil its next-generation operating system for iPhone and other devices at WWDC 2026. Ahead of the developer conference, a seasoned journalist has suggested that Apple will heavily position privacy as the defining feature of its AI strategy, and one of its defining features could be automatic chat deletion.
title: Standalone Siri App to Reportedly Feature Chat Auto Deletion as Apple Focuses on Privacy

description: Apple is expected to refresh its hardware lineup as part of the annual cycle in September. While the focus of the rumour mill has been on the purported iPhone 18 series and the highly anticipated iPhone Fold, a recent report suggests that the next-generation Apple Watch, the Watch Series 12, could miss out on significant design overhauls or AI-focused additions. Instead, the purported wearable will reportedly emphasise gradual refinements, software improvements, and new watch faces.
title: Apple Watch Series 12 to Offer Only General Performance Improvements, Bug Fixes: Report
